This is a rare opportunity for an experienced credit leader to take a principal role with genuine influence across credit risk, transaction structuring, portfolio oversight and governance within an established commercial real estate private credit business.

Working closely with executive leadership and investment stakeholders, you'll act as the independent voice of credit across a diversified commercial real estate debt portfolio spanning construction, development, investment and structured lending.

job.title: Manager Business & Oversight
job.description:
Manager, Business and Oversight — Superannuation Trustee

Newly created role | Sydney preferred (Melbourne considered) | Hybrid — 2 days in office

Our client is a growing financial services business building out its Superannuation Trustee function. As part of this uplift, they're creating a new Manager, Business and Oversight role within their Office of the Trustee, a 2nd line function providing independent oversight and assurance over the material service providers that support the Trustee's obligations.

This is a genuine build-and-run opportunity: you'll help shape the frameworks and processes for a newly formed team, while also getting your hands dirty in the day-to-day oversight of a material service provider portfolio.

What you'll do
  • Support the SPS 515 member outcomes assessment — coordinating inputs from service providers and internal stakeholders, analysing metrics and reporting results, and helping prepare papers for management and trustee committees
  • Lead detailed reviews of material service providers against the oversight framework, assessing CPS 230 preparedness including incident management, business continuity and disaster recovery testing
  • Support operational risk and financial resilience (ORFR) obligations, ensuring incidents, control weaknesses and remediation actions are documented, escalated and tracked to resolution
  • Contribute to product governance — reviewing product change proposals and service provider impacts against DDO obligations, and monitoring Target Market Determinations for triggers and breaches
  • Review service provider controls over member communications and disclosures, and oversee resolution of any related issues or incidents
What you'll bring
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in business, commerce, law, finance, risk or governance
  • Experience in superannuation, a trustee office, risk, governance, oversight, audit or service provider management — ideally within an APRA-regulated environment
  • Working knowledge of SPS 515, CPS 230, operational risk frameworks, member outcomes and product governance requirements
  • APRA experience is essential; ASIC exposure highly regarded
  • FAR (Financial Accountability Regime) experience is a plus
  • Strong analytical and issue-management skills, with the ability to interpret service provider data and drive practical remediation
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to constructively challenge service providers and senior stakeholders while maintaining collaborative relationships
What's on offer
A competitive package plus a discretionary bonus, with genuine scope to shape a brand-new function inside a maturing trustee office.
